description: This file defines the InstanceAPI class, a REST controller handling POST and GET requests for managing instance installation data such as organization name, country code, language code, and timezone within the OrangeHRM installer. It facilitates data validation, state management, and retrieval of instance configuration.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: A REST controller class for managing instance installation data via API endpoints, providing methods to handle POST (create/update) and GET (retrieve) requests

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to store instance data like organization name, country code, language code, and timezone after validating input parameters.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored instance data, including organization name, country, language, and timezone information.
